dis_aflatoxicosis_desc: Toksin poisin i kam long ol wit o kaikai i gat 'mold' na dispela i save bagarapim 'liver' na 'jaundice'.
dis_aflatoxicosis_prev: Noken givim ol kaikai i gat 'mold', putim ol wit samting long ples we i drai, na yusim ol marasin bilong pasim marasin nogut.
dis_anaplasmosis_desc: Ol sik we i save kamap long ol binatang jem we i save kamapim 'anemia', fiva, na 'jaundice'.
dis_anemia_desc: Em i save kamap long ol liklik buai insait long haus we i no gat ol marasin bilong ain.
dis_anemia_prev: Ol sut bilong ain taim pikinini i bon.
dis_anthrax_desc: Bikpela sik bilong ol binatang jem we inap long bagarapim ol manmeri.
dis_anthrax_prev: Givim sut na noken opim bodi bilong ol animal.
dis_ascaris_desc: Ol binatang nogut insait long bodi i save bagarapim lewa na lewa.
dis_asf_desc: Wanpela sik we i save kalap hariap na i save kilim man na i save kamap planti long Wes Afrika. Nogat wanpela sut i stap.
dis_asf_prev: Strongim 'biosecurity' na tambuim ol manmeri long go insait long fam.
dis_babesiosis_desc: Blut binatang we i save kalap long ol 'tick' na i save kamapim bikpela fiva, 'anemia', na blakpela pispis.
dis_babesiosis_prev: Kontrolim ol tik yusim ol marasin bilong kilim ol tik na larim ol banis i no gat ol diwai na gras.
dis_biotin_deficiency_desc: Sapos man i sot long kaikai, dispela i save mekim na lek bilong lek i bruk, skin i gat sua, na lek nogut.
dis_biotin_deficiency_prev: Givim 'biotin' long kaikai na abrusim ol simen plua we i no strong tumas.
dis_brucellosis_desc: Sik bilong ol binatang jem we i save kamapim hevi long karim pikinini.
dis_bvdv_pig_desc: Bovine Viral Diarrhea vaires infeksen taim man i bungim ol bulmakau, na dispela i mekim na ol i rausim bel.
dis_bvdv_pig_prev: Putim ol pik i stap longwe long ol bulmakau na sipsip, na tambuim ol 'crossspecies' kontek.
dis_c_difficile_desc: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem long ol nupela pikinini buai i save kamapim pekpek wara na bel i solap.
dis_c_difficile_prev: Klinim na kilim ol jem gut long ol banis bilong ol bebi na mekim 'colostrum' i kamap hariap.
dis_cassava_poisoning_desc: Posin bilong 'cyanide' long ol rop o skin bilong maniok we ol i no bin kukim o ol i no bin prosesim gut.
dis_cassava_poisoning_prev: Rausim skin bilong maniok, boilim, draim long san, o mekim maniok i kamap strong pastaim long yu givim kaikai.
dis_clostridial_desc: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem i save bagarapim tru bel.
dis_clostridial_prev: Givim sut long ol bulmakau meri na klinim bodi.
dis_coccidiosis_desc: Sik bilong ol binatang nogut i save kamap long ol liklik buai.
dis_cold_stress_desc: Bikpela kol bilong bodi bilong ol pikinini buai, na dispela i save mekim ol i guria na planti i save dai.
dis_cold_stress_prev: Givim ol 'heat lamp', ol 'creep box', na mekim ples bilong karim pikinini i drai na i no gat win.
dis_congenital_tremor_desc: Neurological kondisen long ol nupela pikinini buai i save mekim ol i guria nogut tru.
dis_congenital_tremor_prev: Noken yusim wara bilong ol 'boar' we i gat sik na daunim hevi bilong 'sow' taim em i gat bel.
dis_csf_desc: Sik we i save kalap hariap tru wankain olsem ASF.
dis_cysticercosis_desc: Larval stej bilong human tapeworm insait long masol bilong buai.
dis_cysticercosis_prev: Stopim rot bilong kisim ol pipia bilong ol man.
dis_deltacoronavirus_desc: Viral pekpek wara long olgeta krismas.
dis_demodectic_mange_desc: Skin mite we i no klia tumas na i save kamapim ol liklik mak na ol liklik 'pustules'.
dis_demodectic_mange_prev: Mekim gutpela kaikai bilong ol animal, rausim ol buai i gat sik, na putim marasin bilong kilim ol buai.
dis_dysentery_prev: Wara marasin na kilim ol binatang.
dis_ear_biting: Pasin bilong kaikai man long yau
dis_ear_biting_desc: Nogut pasin we ol buai i save kaikaim yau bilong ol poroman bilong ol, na dispela i save kamapim sik 'necrosis'.
dis_ear_biting_prev: Daunim pasin bilong bungim planti manmeri, mekim win i kam insait gut, na givim ol samting olsem ol sen.
dis_ear_necrosis_desc: Planti taim dispela i save kamap bikos long hevi, planti manmeri tumas, o sik.
dis_ear_necrosis_prev: Daunim density na tritim seken infeksen.
dis_edema_desc: Em i kamap long ol marasin nogut bilong E. coli long ol liklik buai we ol i lusim susu.
dis_emcv_desc: Viral infeksen we i save kamap long ol rat na i save mekim hat i no wok gut na rausim bel.
dis_emcv_prev: Mekim strongpela wok bilong bosim ol rat na lukautim kaikai bilong ol long ol binatang nogut.
dis_endocarditis_desc: Het valv infeksen i save mekim hat i no wok gut na dai wantu tasol long taim bilong hevi.
dis_endocarditis_prev: Tritim hariap ol sik na sua long ol join, na makim ol 'genetics' we inap long kisim sik.
dis_eperythrozoonosis_desc: Blut binatang i save kamapim sik 'anemia'.
dis_eperythrozoonosis_prev: Kontrolim ol binatang na klinim ol nil.
dis_ergotism_desc: Posin bilong ol 'fungal' long ol 'serial greins' we i gat sik 'ergot', na dispela i save kamapim bagarap long ol 'tissue necrosis'.
dis_ergotism_prev: Skrinim ol kaikai bilong kaikai long ol 'dark ergot body' na senisim ol kaikai we i gat doti long en.
dis_erysipelas_desc: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem we i save kamapim ol sua long skin na sik atraitis.
dis_erysipelas_prev: Givim sut oltaim na klinim pen.
dis_fascioliasis_desc: Parasitic fluke i save bagarapim 'liver', we i save kamap long ol ples we i gat wara o ples tais.
dis_fascioliasis_prev: Pasim ol buai long kaikai gras long ol ples we i gat planti tais na kontrolim ol 'mud snail'.
dis_fmd_desc: Sik bilong vaires i save kamapim ol sua long maus na lek.
dis_foot_rot_desc: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem i go insait long ol bagarap long lek, na i save mekim lek i bagarap na lek nogut.
dis_foot_rot_prev: Stretim ol simen we i no gutpela, larim plua i stap drai, na yusim ol ples bilong waswas long lek sapos i gat nid.
dis_gastric_torsion_desc: Bel i pulap na i tantanim wantu tasol, na dispela i mekim na man i dai hariap.
dis_gastric_torsion_prev: Noken givim bikpela kaikai bihain long yu tambu long kaikai longpela taim na brukim kaikai bilong olgeta de i go long ol liklik hap.
dis_glassers_desc: I save kamapim sua long ol 'membrane' klostu long bel, lewa, na ol join.
dis_gossypol_toxicity_desc: Poisin i kamap taim man i kaikai 'raw' o planti 'cottonseed', na dispela i save kamapim hevi long pulim win.
dis_gossypol_toxicity_prev: Noken kaikai planti 'cottonseed' na yusim 'iron sulfate' long daunim 'gossypol'.
dis_greasy_pig: Sik bilong pik i gat gris
dis_greasy_pig_desc: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem we i save kamapim ol sua long skin.
dis_greasy_pig_prev: Senitesen na ol marasin bilong kilim ol binatang jem.
dis_heat_stroke_desc: I hat tumas bikos i no gat gutpela win o sedo.
dis_hydatid_disease_desc: Infeksen bilong ol 'parasitic larval' we i save kamapim ol 'cyst' we i pulap long wara insait long ol bodi bodi.
dis_hydatid_disease_prev: Yu mas rausim ol 'worm' long ol dok bilong fam oltaim na pasim ol long kaikai ol 'raw organ' bilong buai.
dis_hyostrongylosis_desc: Sik bilong 'stomach worm' we i save kamapim sik 'gastritis', 'anemia', na 'weight loss'.
dis_hyostrongylosis_prev: Senisim ol gras, mekim haus i stap drai, na bihainim wanpela sediul bilong rausim ol binatang nogut.
dis_ileitis_desc: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem long liklik 'intestine'.
dis_influenza_desc: Sik bilong pulim win we i save kalap hariap.
dis_iron_toxicity_desc: Em inap kamap sapos ol i sutim ain long ol liklik buai we i sot long Vit E.
dis_iron_toxicity_prev: Mekim gut olsem kaikai bilong ol bulmakau i gat gutpela mak.
dis_je_prev: Kontrolim ol moskito na givim sut.
dis_kidney_worms_desc: Ol binatang jem insait long bodi i save bagarapim ol kidni na leva.
dis_leptospirosis_desc: Sik bilong ol binatang jem we i save bagarapim ol kidni.
dis_leptospirosis_prev: Kontrolim ol rat na givim sut.
dis_lice_desc: Ol binatang nogut i save pulim blut.
dis_lice_prev: Tritmen bilong marasin bilong kilim ol binatang.
dis_listeriosis_desc: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem long 'nervous system'.
dis_mange_desc: Sik bilong skin we i save kamapim bikpela pen.
dis_melioidosis_desc: Sik bilong ol binatang jem i kam long graun/wara.
dis_mma_desc: Mastitis, metritis, na agalactia i save kamapim fiva na sot long susu long ol bulmakau meri bihain long ol i karim pikinini.
dis_mma_prev: Lukautim gutpela pasin bilong lukautim banis bilong ol bulmakau na mekim gutpela kaikai long ol bulmakau.
dis_mulberry_heart_desc: Sot long kaikai i save bagarapim bel.
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis_desc: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem we i save mekim ol join i solap, lek nogut, na lek i no strong.
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis_prev: Mekim gutpela sindaun bilong haus, daunim namba bilong ol animal, na tritim hariap.
dis_mycotoxicosis_desc: Em i kamap long kaikai we i gat 'mold' long en.
dis_mycotoxicosis_prev: Ol samting bilong pasim marasin nogut na drai stoa.
dis_navel_bleeding_desc: Planti blut i save ron long 'umbilical cord' bilong ol nupela pikinini buai.
dis_navel_bleeding_prev: Pasim rop bilong bel taim pikinini i bon na noken givim kaikai i gat 'mycotoxin' long ol bulmakau meri.
dis_navel_ill_desc: Infeksen long rop bilong bel taim pikinini i bon.
dis_navel_ill_prev: Iodine dip long taim bilong karim pikinini na senitesen.
dis_necrotic_enteritis_desc: Sik bilong ol binatang jem we i save kamapim bikpela pekpek wara na planti pikinini buai i save dai.
dis_necrotic_enteritis_prev: Givim sut long ol bulmakau meri pastaim long ol i karim pikinini na lukautim gut banis.
dis_oesophagostomiasis_desc: Intestinal parasit i save kamapim ol nodul long wol bilong bel, na dispela i save mekim ol bulmakau i kamap liklik.
dis_oesophagostomiasis_prev: Oltaim klinim pen na yusim ol bikpela marasin bilong kilim ol binatang.
dis_parakeratosis_desc: Sik bilong kaikai i save kamapim ol bikpela sua long skin.
dis_parakeratosis_prev: Mekim gutpela mak bilong 'calcium-to-zinc' insait long kaikai na givim ol 'zinc suplement'.
dis_pcv2_desc: I save kamapim hevi long westim na pulim win long ol groa.
dis_ped_desc: Wankain olsem TGE, em i save kilim planti bebi.
dis_phe_desc: Bikpela pekpek wara na dai wantu tasol long ol buai we i save groim/pinis.
dis_phe_prev: Lukautim gutpela ples bilong klinim na yusim ol stretpela marasin bilong kilim jem aninit long stia bilong dokta bilong ol animal.
dis_photosensitization_desc: Bikpela san i save kamap long ol buai i gat waitpela skin bihain long ol i kaikai sampela kain diwai.
dis_photosensitization_prev: Givim sedo, rausim ol gras nogut we i save mekim ol i kisim sik, na putim ol buai insait long haus.
dis_pityriasis_rosea_desc: Skin we i no inap kalap long ol narapela long ol yangpela buai we i save kamapim ol 'ring-like crusts'.
dis_pityriasis_rosea_prev: Planti taim em i save stretim hevi bilong em yet; lukautim klinpela, draipela bet na daunim hevi.
dis_pneumonia_desc: Sik bilong pulim win we i save mekim man i no gro gut.
dis_pneumonia_prev: Vaksinesen na gutpela rot bilong pulim win.
dis_polyserositis_desc: 'Fibrinous inflammation' bilong 'lung', 'heart', na ol 'joint surfaces' bilong ol 'weaners'.
dis_polyserositis_prev: Daunim hevi bilong lusim susu, noken miksim ol pikinini, na givim gutpela win.
dis_pox_desc: Sik bilong skin we i save kamap long ol binatang jem, planti taim ol liklik binatang i save kalap long en.
dis_ppv_desc: As bilong hevi bilong karim pikinini long ol 'gilts'.
dis_ppv_prev: Givim sut pastaim long karim pikinini.
dis_prdc_desc: Ol sik bilong pulim win we i save kamap long ol vaires na baktiria we i save mekim man i kus na i no gro gut.
dis_prdc_prev: Mekim gutpela rot bilong pulim win, noken pulap tumas, na bosim ol namba wan vaires.
dis_prrs_desc: I save kamapim hevi long pulim win na hevi long karim pikinini.
dis_prrs_prev: Biosekyuriti na givim sut long ol animal.
dis_pseudorabies_desc: Sik bilong vaires we i save bagarapim ol 'nervous' na 'respiratory system'.
dis_pseudorabies_prev: Ol program bilong givim sut na pinisim sik.
dis_pss_desc: Jenetik kondisen we i kamap long hevi.
dis_pss_prev: Jenetik seleksen na pasin bilong lukautim gut.
dis_pwd: Pekpek wara bihain long lusim susu (PWD)
dis_pwd_desc: Pekpek wara i save kamap long ol liklik buai bihain liklik long ol i lusim susu, na dispela i save mekim ol i sot long wara.
dis_pwd_prev: Daunim hevi bilong lusim susu, lukautim gutpela klinim ples, na givim klinpela wara bilong dring.
dis_rabies_desc: Sik bilong vaires we i save kilim man i save kamap long ol man i kaikaim man.
dis_rabies_prev: Givim sut long ol animal bilong haus na kontrolim ol wel animal.
dis_rectal_prolapse_desc: Planti taim i save kamap bihain long kus, pekpek wara, o kol.
dis_rectal_prolapse_prev: Lukluk long namba wan as na operesen.
dis_rhinitis_desc: I save mekim maus i paul na i gat hevi long pulim win.
dis_rickets_desc: Sot long kaikai i save bagarapim gro bilong bun.
dis_rickets_prev: Ol mineral na sanlait i stap gut.
dis_ringworm_desc: Sik long skin we i save kamap long ol binatang jem.
dis_rotavirus_desc: As bilong pekpek wara taim em i lusim susu.
dis_salmonella_septicemia_desc: Bikpela sik salmonella long blut we i save kamapim pepol skin na dai hariap.
dis_salmonella_septicemia_prev: Putim ol sik buai i stap wanpis, givim marasin wara, na lukautim gut 'biosecurity'.
dis_salmonellosis_desc: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem i save kamapim ol bikpela hevi long bel.
dis_salt_poisoning_desc: Em i kamap bikos i no gat wara na bihain ol i dring planti tumas.
dis_seneca_desc: I save kamapim ol sua wankain olsem FMD.
dis_shoulder_ulcers_desc: Ol sua i stap long solda bilong ol liklik bulmakau meri we i stap antap long strongpela simen.
dis_shoulder_ulcers_prev: Givim ol malumalum bet, lukautim ol bulmakau long gutpela bodi, na yusim ol mat bilong raba.
dis_sow_hysteria_desc: Hevi bilong pasin we ol buai i save karim pikinini i save kros na kaikaim ol pikinini buai.
dis_sow_hysteria_prev: Givim wanpela kwaet ples bilong karim pikinini, lukautim ol 'gilt', na yusim ol marasin bilong daunim bel hevi sapos i gat nid.
dis_spirochetal_colitis_desc: Sik bilong pekpek wara i no bikpela tumas long ol buai i wok long gro, na i save mekim ol i no kisim gutpela hevi.
dis_spirochetal_colitis_prev: Klinim ol ples bilong kaikai na givim marasin bilong kilim ol buai long ol buai i gat sik.
dis_splayleg_desc: Ol liklik pik i bon na ol i no inap sanap wantaim baksait lek.
dis_strep_desc: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem we i save kamapim sik 'meningitis'.
dis_strongyloidiasis_desc: Intestinal threadworm i save kamapim bikpela pekpek wara na dai long ol pikinini buai.
dis_strongyloidiasis_prev: Larim ol bokis bilong karim pikinini i drai na klin, na rausim ol binatang jem pastaim long karim pikinini.
dis_sunburn_desc: I save bagarapim ol buai i gat waitpela skin ausait.
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity_desc: Poisin i kam long ol swit poteto we i gat 'mold', na dispela i save kamapim bikpela hevi long pulim win.
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity_prev: Tromoi ol swit poteto we i bagarap o i gat 'mold'; givim ol helti rop tasol.
dis_tail_biting_desc: Hevi bilong pasin bikos long stres/les.
dis_tail_biting_prev: Daunim hevi na mekim envairomen i kamap gutpela.
dis_tb_desc: Sik bilong ol baktiria we i save stap longpela taim.
dis_tb_prev: Pasin bilong pasim ol pisin na klinim ples.
dis_tetanus_desc: Posin bilong ol binatang jem we i save bagarapim 'nervous system'.
dis_tetanus_prev: Klinpela samting long taim bilong operesen/kastresen.
dis_tge_desc: Sik bilong vaires we i save kilim planti liklik buai.
dis_thorny_headed_worm_desc: Ol 'parasitic worm' i save kisim taim ol i kaikaim ol 'beetle', na dispela i save kamapim hul long bel.
dis_thorny_headed_worm_prev: Noken lukautim fri long ol graun we i gat ol 'beetle' na yusim ol marasin bilong rausim ol binatang jem.
dis_trichinellosis_desc: Sik bilong ol animal we i save kamap taim man i kaikai ol hap mit we i no kukim yet, na dispela i save mekim ol masol i kamap strong.
dis_trichinellosis_prev: Noken givim kaikai long ol 'swill', boilim ol hap kaikai inap 30 minit, na bosim ol rat.
dis_trypanosomiasis_desc: Sik bilong ol 'protozoan' we ol 'tsetse' flai i save kalap long en.
dis_ulcers_desc: Em i kamap long gutpela kaikai o hevi.
dis_ulcers_prev: Stretim sais bilong ol liklik hap kaikai.

dis_vesicular_desc: Sik bilong vaires i wankain olsem FMD.
dis_vs_desc: I save kamapim ol sua; i luk olsem FMD.

dis_vulvovaginitis_desc: Em i kamap long ol 'estrogenic fungal toxins' insait long kaikai.

guide_breeding_step1_desc: Lukluk long 'standing reflex', 'vulva' i solap, na ol 'vocalizations'. Rekodim naturela sevis o AI wantaim ol ditel bilong 'boar tag'.
guide_breeding_step1_tip: Gutpela pasin em long givim kaikai long bulmakau tupela taim: 12-pela aua namel long tupela long taim bilong bikpela hat.
guide_breeding_step2_desc: SmartSwine i save sediulim ol 'heat check' gen long 18-24 de na ol 'farrowing alert' long 110-114 de.
guide_breeding_step2_tip: Sekim sapos em i go bek long hat klostu long De 21. Sapos 'sow' i soim hat i sanap, sevis gen hariap.
guide_breeding_step3_desc: Disinfektim ol bokis bilong karim pikinini na muvim ol meri i gat bel 4 i go inap 5-pela de pastaim long de bilong karim pikinini. Redim ol lam bilong hatim ol liklik buai.
guide_breeding_step3_tip: Larim hap we ol liklik pik i save stap long en i stap hat (30-32°C) long stopim 'hypothermia' long ol nupela bebi.
guide_breeding_step4_desc: Log Born Alive, Stillborns, Mummies, na Total Litter Birth Weight long skelim wok bilong mama bilong bulmakau.
guide_breeding_step4_tip: Givim ain injeksen na katim tit bilong nil insait long 24-48 aua bihain long taim mama i karim pikinini.
guide_breeding_subtitle: Trakim ol 'heat cycles' bilong ol 'sow', ol de bilong givim kaikai, 114-de 'gestation', na ol 'farrowing litters'.
guide_breeding_title: Ol taim bilong karim pikinini na karim pikinini
guide_feed_step1_desc: Go long 'Feed' na opim 'Feed Formulation' tul long wokim o stretim ol 'custom feeding rations'.
guide_feed_step1_tip: Sekim ol prais bilong ol samting bilong kukim kaikai pastaim long painimaut wanem kain protin na eneji i no gat bikpela pe tumas.
guide_feed_step2_desc: Yu mas makim 'target' buai stej (Krip, Stata, Growa, Pinisim, Gestating Sow, Lactating Sow) long putim ol standet nutrien rikwaemen.
guide_feed_step2_tip: Ol buai i save gro i nidim planti krud protin (16-18%) winim ol buai i gat bel (12-14%).
guide_feed_step3_desc: Putim ol samting olsem Maiz, Soya Meal, Wit Bran, Fishmeal, na Premix. Skelim ol pesen inap long ol 'nutrient bar' i kamap grin.
guide_feed_step3_tip: Mekim gut olsem 'Calcium to Phosphorus' (Ca:P) resio i stap namel long 1.2:1 na 1.6:1 bilong helpim bun i kamap gut.
guide_feed_step4_desc: Sevim 'balanced recipe' bilong yu long kisim hariap, o logim wanpela 'mixed batch' long apdetim 'feed inventory' otomatik.
guide_feed_step4_tip: Miksim kaikai long wankain hap na putim long ol drai, antap palet long stopim aflatoxin na bagarap.
guide_feed_subtitle: Disainim ol kaikai we i no gat bikpela pe na i gat planti gutpela kaikai long en long olgeta hap bilong prodaksen.
guide_feed_title: Wokim na skelim gut ol kaikai
guide_finances_step1_desc: Raitim olgeta mani we ol i tromoi long fam we i stap long ol kategori bilong Fid, Veterineri, Leba, Yutiliti, na Mentenens.
guide_finances_step1_tip: Logim ol ekspens taim ol i baim ol samting bai ol kos analitik i stap gut.
guide_finances_step2_desc: Rekodim mani yu kisim long salim ol animal i stap laip, ol animal ol i kilim, ol animal bilong karim pikinini, o ol 'organic manure'.
guide_finances_step2_tip: Rekodim tupela samting, laip weit na laspela prais bilong wan wan kilo bilong bihainim ol mak bilong maket.
guide_finances_step3_desc: Lukluk gen long COP long wan wan kg na prais bilong Finisher Breakeven long meksua olsem olgeta wan wan transeksen i kamapim gutpela winmani.
guide_finances_step3_tip: Fid i mas makim 65-75% bilong olgeta prodaksen kos bilong yu. Daunim westim kaikai.
guide_finances_subtitle: Lukluk long ol ekspens, reveniu bilong ol sels, na skelim kos bilong prodaksen long wan wan kg.
guide_health_step1_desc: Yusim 'Disease Finder' tul long makim ol mak bilong sik (kus, pekpek wara, sua) wantaim ol sik bilong ol buai.
guide_health_step1_tip: Putim ol sik animal i go insait long ol 'quarantine pen' pastaim long yu statim tritmen.
guide_health_step1_title: Painimaut bilong ol mak bilong sik
guide_health_step2_desc: Rekodim ol marasin bilong kilim binatang o ol binatang jem na raitim gut ol de bilong lusim mit.
guide_health_step2_tip: Noken maketim o kilim wanpela animal pastaim long taim bilong kisim mit i pinis.
guide_health_step3_desc: Lukautim gut ol 'footbath' wantaim marasin bilong kilim ol binatang, bosim ol manmeri i kam long fam, klinim ol kar, na putim ol nupela stok long kwarentin inap 30 de.
guide_health_step3_tip: Biosekyuriti em i 10-pela taim moa isi long tritim wanpela sik i kamap.
guide_health_subtitle: Luksave long ol hevi bilong sik, bihainim ol tritmen protokol, na lukautim gut 'biosecurity'.
guide_health_title: Painim sik na sekyuriti bilong laip
guide_herd_step1_desc: Go insait long 'Herd Data' long bikpela 'dashboard' o 'drawer menu' bilong lukim olgeta 'herd registry' bilong yu.
guide_herd_step1_tip: Yu ken sekim ol rekot bilong ol animal long 'status' (Active, Sold, Cull) yusim ol 'status tab'.
guide_herd_step2_desc: Taitim '+' floting baten. Putim ol bikpela infomesen: Tag ID, Breed, Sex, Birth Deit, na Pen i stap.
guide_herd_step2_tip: Givim ol klia, standet tag ID (e.g., SOW-001, BOAR-01) bilong isi long bihainim olgeta fam.
guide_herd_step3_desc: Opim 'profile card' bilong olgeta animal long kisim ol hevi bilong skel, ol sut, 'deworming', o ol marasin.
guide_herd_step3_tip: Skelim hevi bilong bodi oltaim i helpim long skelim stretpela 'Average Daily Gain' (ADG) na painimaut sik hariap.
guide_herd_step4_desc: Grupim ol buai we i wok long gro i go insait long ol banis o ol 'batch grup' bilong sekim gut namba bilong ol buai na hamas kaikai ol i kisim.
guide_herd_step4_tip: Noken putim ol banis we i pulap tumas long stopim pasin bilong kaikaim na mekim animal i gro wankain.
guide_herd_step4_title: Givim ol pen na ol lain
guide_herd_subtitle: Rejistretim ol animal, lukautim ol 'ear tag', makim ol 'pen', na bihainim lain bilong ol.
guide_hr_step1_desc: Rejistretim ol wokman, ol menesa bilong fam, na ol dokta bilong ol animal i gat rait long go insait long wok bilong ol.
guide_hr_step1_tip: Pasin bilong pasim ol edmin na menesa long kisim mani i save lukautim ol sensitif rekot.
guide_hr_step1_title: Putim ol memba bilong tim na givim ol wok
guide_hr_step2_desc: Givim ol wok bilong olgeta de olsem givim kaikai long banis, klinim wara, was long taim bilong karim bebi, na luksave long hat.
guide_hr_step2_tip: Ol klia 'task checklists' i stopim ol 'missed fieding' o 'delay' bilong kisim marasin.
guide_hr_step2_title: Givim ol wok na sediul bilong olgeta de
guide_hr_step3_desc: Raitim ol pe bilong pe, bonus, na ol didaksen long holim wanpela klia, oganais peirol histri.
guide_hr_step3_tip: Oltaim putim ol toksave long ol pefomens bonas o ol salari advans bilong mekim wok odit i kamap klia.

tip_100_content: Putim ol klia imejensi kontek na ol instraksen i stap klostu long dua bilong go insait sapos pawa i pinis, wara i katim, o paia i ken kamap.
tip_10_content: Bungim ol liklik buai we i gat wankain sais wantaim taim ol i lusim susu. Dispela i save pasim ol bikpela pikinini buai long bihainim pasin bilong bosim na bungim kaikai.
tip_11_content: Givim wanpela liklik pe, hommeid electrolyte solusen (5 spun suga, 1/2 spun sol insait long 5 lita klinpela wara) long namba wan 3 de bilong lusim susu long daunim hevi.
tip_11_title: Solusen bilong kisim bek wara long haus
tip_12_content: Sapos yu givim pipia bilong haus kuk long ol pikinini we i lusim susu, oltaim boilim inap 30 minit long kilim ol vaires na baktiria pastaim long yu givim kaikai.
tip_12_title: Sefti bilong ol pipia bilong haus kuk
tip_13_content: Givim wankain kaikai bilong stat inap 5-pela de bihain long yu lusim susu pastaim long yu miksim isi isi wantaim kaikai bilong groa insait long 7-pela de bilong stopim pekpek wara.
tip_14_content: Putim wanpela tikpela hap bilong drai gras, ol hap diwai, o drai gras long hap bilong slip bilong mekim ol liklik buai i stap hat na yu no ken yusim ol 'heater' we i gat bikpela pe.
tip_14_title: Ol drai bet bilong mekim hat
tip_15_content: Mekim gut olsem olgeta pikinini buai i ken kaikai long wankain taim long rot bilong givim ol longpela, liklik diwai o simen 'feed trough' (olsem 15-20cm spes bilong 'trough' long wan wan liklik buai).
tip_16_content: Hangim ol grin banana stem we i bruk bruk long banis bilong rausim susu. Ol liklik buai i save kaikaim ol, na dispela i save mekim ol i stap isi na i no save kaikaim tel bilong ol.
tip_17_content: Putim wanpela klinpela 'shovel' bilong nupela, retpela graun (i kam long wanpela klinpela hap) insait long banis bilong karim bebi. Ol liklik buai i save kaikai dispela bilong kisim ain na mineral.
tip_18_content: Putim ol wara o ol 'nipple drinker' i stap daunbilo inap (bek-hait bilong liklik buai) bai olgeta buai we i lusim susu i ken dring isi.
tip_19_content: Opim 'partition' namel long tupela 'farrowing pens' wanpela wik pastaim long ol i lusim susu bilong larim ol pikinini buai i ken bung wantaim, na daunim pait taim ol i bungim ol bihain.
tip_1_content: Gutpela kwaliti kaikai em i bikpela samting. Mekim gut olsem ol buai i gat gutpela wara na gutpela kaikai we i stret long taim ol i gro.
tip_20_content: Boilim ol samting bilong egrikalsa olsem skin bilong yam, skin bilong maniok, na poteto rop bilong bagarapim ol marasin nogut na mekim gutpela kaikai.
tip_20_title: Boiling bilong ol samting bilong egrikalsa
tip_21_content: Givim kaikai bilong ol bisnis long groim ol kaikai we i gat planti protin olsem Moringa, Azolla, o ol lip bilong swit poteto long fam.
tip_22_content: Larim ol bulmakau meri i gat bel long kisim 2-2.5 kg kaikai long wan wan de bilong stopim ol long kamap patpela tumas, we i save kamapim hevi long karim pikinini.
tip_22_title: Tambuim kaikai bilong meri i gat bel
tip_23_content: Miksim ol samting we i no gat bikpela pe olsem 'rice bran', 'wheat bran', o 'copra meal' insait long kaikai bilong 'sow gestation' bilong mekim ol i pulap na stap isi.
tip_23_title: Lokal Fiber bilong ol bulmakau meri
tip_24_content: Yusim ol plastik barel o dram we ol i bin yusim gen na i gat ol 'nipple drinker' olsem wanpela gutpela na klinpela wara sistem bilong olgeta banis bilong buai.
tip_24_title: Ol Graviti Dringa we i no gat bikpela pe
tip_25_content: Putim ol beg bilong kaikai long ol diwai palet we i no stap long simen plua na longwe long ol wol bilong stopim wet na gro bilong mold.
tip_25_title: Stoa bilong kaikai long taim bilong ren
tip_26_content: Boilim ol pipia bilong kaikai bilong hotel o haus kuk inap 30 minit long bagarapim ol vairas bilong Afrikan Swine Fiva na sik bilong lek na maus.
tip_26_title: Boilim ol pipia bilong haus kuk
tip_27_content: Yusim 'wet brewer's grain' olsem wanpela liklik pe bilong kaikai, tasol putim long 30-40% bilong 'ration' na givim em nupela kaikai bilong abrusim 'mold poison'.
tip_28_content: Putim ol liklik hap sit bilong paiawut insait long ol 'grower pen'. Ol buai i save kaikaim bilong helpim long pasim ol marasin nogut long bel na daunim pekpek wara.
tip_29_content: Givim susu long ol bulmakau meri 3-pela o 4-pela liklik kaikai long de (i no wanpela bikpela kaikai) long strongim ol long kaikai planti na kamapim planti susu.
tip_2_content: Biosekyuriti em i ki. Noken givim planti manmeri i kam lukim yu, givim ples bilong waswas long lek, na bihainim strongpela sediul bilong kisim sut wantaim dokta bilong ol animal.
tip_30_content: Taim yu miksim kaikai long fam, miksim ol liklik samting (ol vaitamin, sol, mineral) i go insait long liklik hap kon pastaim pastaim long miksim i go insait long bikpela hip.
tip_31_content: Noken kisim Leucaena (ipil-ipil) lip kaikai aninit long 5% bilong kaikai, long wanem, em i gat mimosine we inap long mekim gras i lus na kamapim hevi long karim pikinini.
tip_32_content: Givim kaikai long ol liklik bulmakau long taim bilong 'gestation', na daunim kaikai bilong ol 'fat sow' long holim gutpela bodi kondisen.
tip_33_content: Klinim ol ples bilong dring long olgeta de. Sapos wara i luk doti o smel nogut long yu, em i no gutpela long ol buai bilong yu.
tip_34_content: Bringim buai long hat i go long banis bilong buai bilong karim pikinini, na noken larim buai i ran nating insait long lain buai.
tip_34_title: Hand Mating insait long Breeding Pen
tip_35_content: Testim hat long rot bilong presim han bilong yu strong long baksait bilong buai; sapos em i sanap isi na pasim yau bilong em, em i redi long poroman.
tip_36_content: Skrapim ol banis bilong ol bebi wantaim miks bilong agrikalsa laim na wara (waitwas) long kilim ol jem long ol wol na plua long liklik pe.
tip_37_content: Draim ol nupela bebi we i wet kwiktaim yusim ol klinpela, drai bek o laplap bilong stopim kol na sik bilong pulim win.
tip_38_content: Sapos yu no inap kisim sut bilong ain, orait yu mas rapim klinpela graun na 'iron-sulfate paste' long susu bilong buai long olgeta de bai ol pikinini buai i ken kisim ain taim ol i givim susu.
tip_38_title: Ol narapela rot bilong kisim ain
tip_3_content: Larim ol nupela pikinini buai i stap hat na meksua olsem ol i kisim 'colostrum' insait long ol namba wan aua bihain long ol i bon long kamapim 'immunity'.
tip_40_content: Yusim wanpela simpol diwai bokis wantaim liklik lait balb o hatpela bet (olsem drai gras) long mekim ol pikinini buai i stap hat long hap we ol i save slip long en.
tip_41_content: Wasim susu na susu bilong pik wantaim klinpela wara na wanpela marasin bilong kilim ol binatang pastaim long em i karim pikinini bilong lukautim ol nupela pikinini buai.
tip_42_content: Rausim 'colostrum' long han long tit bilong pik na givim long ol liklik pik yusim wanpela klinpela 'syringe' o spun.
tip_43_content: Makim de bilong karim pikinini long kalenda; bel i save stap inap 114 de (3-pela mun, 3-pela wik, 3-pela de), na dispela i larim yu long redim ples bilong karim pikinini.
tip_43_title: Kalenda bilong ol rekot bilong karim pikinini
tip_44_content: Kisim ol gilts bilong senisim ol mama we i gat bikpela pikinini, gutpela milk prodaksen, na isi pasin bilong mama.
tip_45_content: Wokabaut wantaim wanpela bikpela buai i go pas long ol gilt pen long olgeta de long strongim ol long kam insait long hat hariap na soim ol klia mak bilong hat.
tip_46_content: Putim wanpela baket bilong klinpela wara klostu long het bilong pik i wok long karim pikinini bai em i ken dring na em i no ken kirap.
tip_46_title: Pikinini Pisin i kisim wara long taim bilong karim pikinini
tip_47_content: Wet inap long wanpela 'gilt' i gat 8-pela mun na i stap long namba tu o namba tri 'heat cycle' bilong em pastaim long yu bungim em long kisim bikpela namba wan pikinini.
tip_48_content: Putim ol nupela buai long wanpela seperet banis we i stap 20 mita longwe long bikpela lain buai bilong yu inap 30 de long sekim sapos ol i gat sik.
tip_48_title: Putim ol nupela samting yu baim
tip_49_content: Putim wanpela plastik tub we i no dip tumas o wanpela hap taia we i pulap long wara na marasin bilong kilim ol binatang (olsem klorin o laim bilong egrikalsa) long geit bilong fam.
tip_4_content: Gutpela pasin bilong holim pekpek i save stopim smel na sik. Tingim long wokim kompos o yusim ol pipia olsem fetilaisa bilong ol kaikai.
tip_50_content: Putim ol groa, ol 'finisher', na ol 'breeding sows' long ol narapela banis bilong stopim ol lapun buai long givim ol sik i go long ol yangpela buai.
tip_51_content: Noken larim ol visita (espeseli ol narapela buai baia o fama) insait long banis bilong buai bilong yu. Toktok long bisnis ausait long pen eria.
tip_52_content: Wokim wanpela simpol banis (yusim mambu, diwai, o 'wire mesh') klostu long haus buai bilong pasim ol dok, wel buai, na ol neiba.
tip_53_content: Putim ol nil yu yusim pinis insait long wanpela plastik botol o kontena we i pas gut pastaim long yu planim o tromoi gut long stopim ol bagarap long aksiden.
tip_53_title: Gutpela rot bilong tromoi ol nil
tip_54_content: Noken larim ol man i baim buai long draivim trak bilong ol klostu long banis bilong buai bilong yu. Putim ol pik we ol i salim long geit bilong fam o long banis.
tip_55_content: Givim ol sid bilong papaya o sid bilong pamkin long ol buai olsem wanpela marasin we i no gat bikpela pe na i save helpim long daunim ol 'internal worm'.
tip_56_content: Sapos ol i pasim tel, orait kilim ol jem long tul bilong katim long wara i boil o alkohol namel long ol pikinini buai bilong stopim sik long kisim yu.
tip_57_content: Klinim na spreim ol banis bilong buai long olgeta wik wantaim wanpela gutpela marasin bilong kilim ol binatang, na meksua olsem ol buai i ken muv o plua i drai hariap.

tos_acceptance_content: Taim yu yusim na yusim SmartSwine ap, yu wanbel long bihainim ol dispela Lo bilong Sevis. Sapos yu no wanbel long ol dispela tok orait, plis noken yusim dispela sevis.
tos_availability_content: Mipela i wok long kisim 99% 'uptime' tasol mipela i no tok tru olsem yu no inap kisim sevis. Ol i givim ol 'data backup' bilong helpim yu; tasol, ol i strongim ol yusa long lukautim ol rekot bilong ol yet.
tos_changes_content: Mipela i gat rait long senisim ol dispela tok orait long wanem taim mipela i laikim. Sapos yu yusim yet dispela ap, dispela i makim olsem yu orait long ol nupela tok.
tos_changes_title: 10. Ol senis long ol tok orait
tos_contact_content: Sapos yu laik kisim sapot o ol askim long sait bilong lo, plis yu ken toktok wantaim divelopa long rot bilong ol seting bilong profail bilong ap.
tos_data_privacy_content:
Yu holim yet onasip bilong ol data yu putim (ol data bilong ol animal, ol fainensel, na ol narapela samting). 
Ol data bilong fam bilong yu i stap gut tru long Google Firebase, taim mipela i wok long lukautim data bilong yu, mipela i no inap long givim gutpela sekyuriti. 
Taim yu opim Cloud Backup, yu orait long ol i ken putim na stretim ol data bilong yu long ol divais bilong yu. 
Mipela i no save salim ol pesonel o fam data bilong yu i go long ol narapela lain.
Yu yet i gat wok long lukautim stretpela bilong ol data yu putim. Ol data we i no stret insait long "Feed" o "Financials" modul i ken kamapim ol rong kalkulesen.
tos_description_content:
"SmartSwine" i save givim ol tul bilong lukautim fam we i gat, tasol i no inap long:
• Traking bilong ol animal na helt data.
• Kipim ol rekot bilong mani.
• Human Risos menesmen.
• Ol tingting bilong painimaut sik we AI i helpim.
• Infomesen bilong kisim maket.
tos_financial_data_content: "Financials" modul em i wanpela tul bilong bihainim na em i no wanpela profesenel akaunting o takis edvais. Ol i strongim ol yusa long salim ol data bilong ol i go aut long ol 'certified accountant' i ken glasim.
tos_liability_content: SmartSwine ap i stap "olsem em i stap." Long mak we lo i tok orait long en, ol divelopa bilong en bai no inap long kisim asua long ol bagarap we i kamap long yusim o no inap long yusim sevis, na tu, ol animal i lus o ol hevi bilong mani.
tos_no_medical_content:
Ol samting bilong "Fed Calculator", "Fed Formulator", "Symptoms Analyzer" na "Disease Finder" em bilong skulim na givim infomesen tasol.
• Ol risal bilong AI i kamap long rot bilong ol 'algorithm' na i no inap long senisim edvais bilong ol dokta bilong ol animal, painimaut sik, o tritmen.
• Yusa i wanbel long toktok wantaim wanpela dokta bilong ol animal i gat laisens pastaim long em i mekim ol disisen long sait bilong kaikai na marasin bilong ol animal.
• Papa bilong dispela ap i no gat asua long ol animal i lus o bagarap i kamap long yusim bilong ap na ol samting bilong en.

• Yusim dispela ap long ol samting we i no stret long lo.
• Traim long senisim aplikesen.
• Putim ol giaman fainensel data bilong giamanim ol narapela lain.

bio_proto_asf: IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY QUARANTINE: African Swine Fever is a lethal, legally notifiable virus. 1) Lock down farm gates immediately. 2) Stop all movement of pigs, vehicles, feed, and manure. 3) Disinfect all boot baths and tyres with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda. 4) Contact your District/National Veterinary Officer immediately.
bio_proto_fmd: NOTIFIABLE EPIDEMIC ALERT: Foot-and-Mouth Disease spreads rapidly through aerosols and equipment. 1) Quarantine suspect pen immediately. 2) No live pigs or personnel movement off-site. 3) Setup tyre baths and boot dips with approved disinfectant. 4) Notify livestock authorities immediately.
bio_proto_csf: NOTIFIABLE DISEASE ALERT: Classical Swine Fever (Hog Cholera). 1) Restrict pen access and isolate suspect animals. 2) Halt all pig sales and shipments. 3) Wear dedicated boots/overalls. 4) Report to official state veterinary services immediately.
bio_proto_anthrax: DANGER - ZOONOTIC EMERGENCY: Bacillus anthracis can infect humans. 1) DO NOT OPEN CARCASSES (exposure to air causes resistant spores). 2) Isolate surviving pigs. 3) Wear full PPE. 4) Call veterinary authorities for safe incineration or deep burial with quicklime.
bio_proto_pseudorabies: NOTIFIABLE HERPESVIRUS ALERT: Pseudorabies / Aujeszky's causes severe neurological fatality in piglets. 1) Strict pen quarantine. 2) Control wild animals and rodents. 3) Notify state veterinary authorities immediately.
bio_proto_rabies: FATAL ZOONOTIC ALERT: Rabies transmits to humans through saliva and bites. 1) DO NOT HANDLE PIG WITH BARE HANDS. 2) Secure pen tightly. 3) Alert veterinary and public health authorities immediately.
bio_proto_vesicular_stomatitis: REPORTABLE VESICULAR LESION ALERT: Vesicular Stomatitis is clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease. 1) Isolate infected pigs immediately. 2) Wear protective gloves. 3) Report to state veterinarian for lab differential diagnosis.
bio_proto_senecavirus: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Senecavirus A lesions are clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). 1) Quarantine pen immediately. 2) Restrict off-farm movement. 3) Notify livestock veterinary authorities for mandatory differential PCR testing.
bio_proto_svd: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Swine Vesicular Disease (SVD). 1) Strict isolation of infected animals. 2) Restrict all vehicle and visitor movements. 3) Report to state animal health department immediately.
